label: ProLiant DL360 Gen11 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with no embedded LOM at all: data networking comes from the OCP 3.0 slot, modelled here as the factory 2-port 10/25GbE adapter. A separate 1GbE dedicated iLO 6 port is always present.
notes: IMPORTANT: Gen11 has zero onboard data NICs. eth0/eth1 represent the 2x 10/25GbE SFP28 OCP 3.0 adapter in OCP slot 1 (a Broadcom 57414-class card), not motherboard ports. Two OCP 3.0 x16 slots exist; a 1GbE copper OCP card is an alternative. iLO 6 port is 1GbE dedicated.
